name: Ro 7-9749
summary: Ro07-9749 is a benzodiazepine derivative with sedative and anxiolytic effects, which has been used as an internal standard in the analysis of other benzodiazepines.

pharmacology.text: Ro07-9749 is a benzodiazepine derivative with sedative and anxiolytic effects, which has been used as an internal standard in the analysis of other benzodiazepines.

uses.text: Ro07-9749 is a benzodiazepine derivative with sedative and anxiolytic effects, which has been used as an internal standard in the analysis of other benzodiazepines.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Benzodiazepines as a group cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory problems and slowed reactions. Regular use leads to dependence, and stopping suddenly after heavy use can cause dangerous withdrawal, including seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平類整體而言會引起嗜睡、協調變差、記憶問題和反應變慢。規律使用會導致依賴，長期大量使用後突然停用可能出現危險的戒斷症狀，包括癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平类整体而言会引起嗜睡、协调制差、记忆问题和反应变慢。规律使用会导致依赖，长期大量使用后突然停用可能出现危险的戒断症状，包括癫痫发作。

fact.en: Ro 7-9749 carries both fluorine and iodine. Its main use has been as an internal standard, a known reference compound added to samples when laboratories measure other benzodiazepines.
fact.zh: Ro 7-9749 同時帶有氟和碘。它的主要用途是作為內標準品，也就是實驗室測量其他苯二氮平時加入樣本的已知參考化合物。
fact.zhHans: Ro 7-9749 同时带有氟和碘。它的主要用途是作为内标准品，也就是实验室测量其他苯二氮平时加入样本的已知参考化合物。
